title: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sents.t: Facebook user Yingy Vong writes, "So something crazy happened tonight.
sents.zh: Facebook 用户 Yingy Vong 写道：“今晚发生了一件疯狂的事。

sents.t: My motion-activated security camera turned on.
sents.zh: 我的感应式监控摄像头启动了。

sents.t: I grabbed my phone to see a live feed of what was happening outside.
sents.zh: 我拿起手机看外面的实时画面。

sents.t: I couldn't believe what I saw."
sents.zh: 我简直不敢相信自己看到了什么。”

sents.t: If the tricycle hadn't stopped and turned, I would have guessed the wind moved it.
sents.zh: 如果那辆三轮车没有停下来再转弯，我会以为是风吹动了它。

sents.t: But as you can see, that doesn't seem to be the case.
sents.zh: 但正如你看到的，似乎并不是这样。
